title: Riot X Nic Salts Blueberry Sour Strawberry 10ml E-Liquid
description: Blueberry Sour Strawberry from Riot X pairs the deep, juicy flavour of ripe blueberries with the bright tang of sour strawberries for a perfectly balanced fruit blend. The soft sweetness of the blueberry rolls in first, followed by the sharp, mouthwatering kick of strawberry, creating a dynamic contrast between sweet and tart. The result is a layered, satisfying vape with a refreshing edge. Part of Riot Squad’s Riot X collection, this e-liquid is crafted to replicate the intense, double-concentrated flavours found in the most popular single-use disposables. Supplied in a 10ml bottle, it’s an excellent choice for vapers switching from disposables to refillable MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod kits, offering the same vibrant taste with the added benefits of convenience and cost efficiency. Please note: this flavour profile may contain hints of 'ice'. Riot X Salt E-Liquids are made with Riot Squad’s Hybrid Nicotine blend, a combination of freebase nicotine and nicotine salts. This innovative mix, along with the 50PG/50VG ratio, ensures a well-balanced vape with rich flavour, a smooth throat hit, and satisfying vapour production.
